item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 07/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be slightly cloudier over the region. There will be one or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Thursday. The weather will be cold in the morning in the latter part of this week and over the weekend. It will be fine and dry over the region. The temperature difference between day and night over inland areas will be rather large. Under the influence of another easterly airstream, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise slightly early to midweek next week.
